versos.grego: Διὸ μηκέτι στέγοντες ηὐδοκήσαμεν καταλειφθῆναι ἐν Ἀθήναις μόνοι,

controles.web: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,
controles.kjv: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
controles.livre: Por isso, como não podíamos mais suportar, decidimos ficar sozinhos em Atenas,

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπέμψαμεν Τιμόθεον, τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν καὶ διάκονον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ, εἰς τὸ στηρίξαι ὑμᾶς καὶ παρακαλέσαι ὑπὲρ τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν

controles.web: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith;
controles.kjv: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
controles.livre: e enviamos Timóteo, nosso irmão e cooperador de Deus  no Evangelho de Cristo, para vos fortalecer e vos encorajar quanto a vossa fé;

versos.grego: τὸ μηδένα σαίνεσθαι ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσιν ταύταις. αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἴδατε ὅτι εἰς τοῦτο κείμεθα·

controles.web: that no one be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.
controles.kjv: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
controles.livre: a fim de que ninguém se abale por essas aflições; pois vós mesmos sabeis que para isso fomos destinados.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ὅτε πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἦμεν, προελέγομεν ὑμῖν ὅτι μέλλομεν θλίβεσθαι, καθὼς καὶ ἐγένετο καὶ οἴδατε.

controles.web: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.
controles.kjv: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
controles.livre: Pois quando ainda estávamos convosco vós dizíamos com antecedência que seríamos afligidos, como aconteceu, e vós sabeis.

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο κἀγὼ μηκέτι στέγων ἔπεμψα εἰς τὸ γνῶναι τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν, μή πως ἐπείρασεν ὑμᾶς ὁ πειράζων καὶ εἰς κενὸν γένηται ὁ κόπος ἡμῶν.

controles.web: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.
controles.kjv: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
controles.livre: Por isso, como não podia mais suportar, eu o enviei para saber de vossa fé. Eu temia que o tentador houvesse vos tentado, e o nosso trabalho houvesse sido inútil.

versos.grego: Ἄρτι δὲ ἐλθόντος Τιμοθέου πρὸς ἡμᾶς ἀφ’ ὑμῶν καὶ εὐαγγελισαμένου ἡμῖν τὴν πίστιν καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην ὑμῶν, καὶ ὅτι ἔχετε μνείαν ἡμῶν ἀγαθὴν πάντοτε, ἐπιποθοῦντες ἡμᾶς ἰδεῖν καθάπερ καὶ ἡμεῖς ὑμᾶς,

controles.web: But when Timothy came just now to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you;
controles.kjv: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
controles.livre: Mas agora, depois que Timóteo voltou a nós da vossa presença, e nos trouxe boas notícias da vossa fé e amor, e de como sempre tendes boa lembrança de nós, e desejais muito nos ver, como também nós a vós;

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο παρεκλήθημεν, ἀδελφοί, ἐφ’ ὑμῖν ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ ἀνάγκῃ καὶ θλίψει ἡμῶν διὰ τῆς ὑμῶν πίστεως,

controles.web: for this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.
controles.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
controles.livre: por isso, irmãos, ficamos consolados acerca de vós em toda a nossa necessidade e aflição, pela vossa fé.

versos.grego: ὅτι νῦν ζῶμεν ἐὰν ὑμεῖς στήκετε ἐν Κυρίῳ.

controles.web: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
controles.kjv: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
controles.livre: Pois agora vivemos, se vós estais firmes no Senhor.

versos.grego: τίνα γὰρ εὐχαριστίαν δυνάμεθα τῷ Θεῷ ἀνταποδοῦναι περὶ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ χαρᾷ ᾗ χαίρομεν δι’ ὑμᾶς ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν,

controles.web: For what thanksgiving can we render again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God;
controles.kjv: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
controles.livre: Pois como agradecemos a Deus por vós, por toda a alegria com que nos alegramos por vossa causa, diante do nosso Deus!

versos.grego: νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ δεόμενοι εἰς τὸ ἰδεῖν ὑμῶν τὸ πρόσωπον καὶ καταρτίσαι τὰ ὑστερήματα τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν;

controles.web: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
controles.kjv: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
controles.livre: E de noite e de dia com extrema intensidade oramos para que possamos ver o vosso rosto, e supramos o que falta na vossa fé.

versos.grego: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Θεὸς καὶ Πατὴρ ἡμῶν καὶ ὁ Κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς κατευθύναι τὴν ὁδὸν ἡμῶν πρὸς ὑμᾶς·

controles.web: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you;
controles.kjv: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
controles.livre: E que o mesmo Deus, nosso Pai, e o nosso Senhor Jesus, preparem o nosso caminho até vós.

versos.grego: ὑμᾶς δὲ ὁ Κύριος πλεονάσαι καὶ περισσεύσαι τῇ ἀγάπῃ εἰς ἀλλήλους καὶ εἰς πάντας, καθάπερ καὶ ἡμεῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς,

controles.web: and the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,
controles.kjv: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
controles.livre: E o Senhor vos faça crescer e exceder em amor uns pelos outros, e por todos, à semelhança de nós por vós;

versos.grego: εἰς τὸ στηρίξαι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας ἀμέμπτους ἐν ἁγιωσύνῃ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ πατρὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
controles.kjv: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
controles.livre: a fim de que fortaleça os vossos corações, irrepreensíveis em santidade diante do nosso Deus e Pai, na vinda do nosso Senhor Jesus com todos os seus santos.
